def replace_params(path: str, param_convertors: dict[str, Convertor[typing.
    Any]], path_params: dict[str, str]) ->tuple[str, dict[str, str]]:
    for key, convertor in list(param_convertors.items()):
        value = path_params.get(key)
        if value is not None:
            assert convertor.regex.fullmatch(str(convertor.to_string(value))), (
                f"Path parameter '{key}' with value '{value}' did not match the expected type."
            )
            path = path.replace("{" + key + "}", convertor.to_string(value))
            path_params.pop(key)
    return path, path_params

def url_path_for(self, name: str, /, **path_params: typing.Any) -> URLPath:
    seen_params = set(path_params.keys())
    expected_params = set(self.param_convertors.keys())

    if name != self.name or seen_params != expected_params:
        raise NoMatchFound(name, path_params)

    path, remaining_params = replace_params(self.path_format, self.param_convertors, dict(path_params))
    assert not remaining_params
    return URLPath(path=path, protocol="http")
